primary_question: Under which stated parameter and workflow assumptions does the proposed method reduce incremental diagnostic cost, grid electricity and electricity-related CO2?

baselines.purpose: Reproduce the submitted static result table
Isolate baseline-discharge subtraction and precision changes under the frozen original reference inputs, not the revised B2 SOC
Use confirmed protocol and explicit energy/cost inputs for sensitivity and MC
baselines.expected_changes: The current B2 reference SOC is 0.4; B0/B1 retain original SOC 0.6. Report this state change, efficiency and derived equipment-rate changes separately from uncertainty propagation.

reference_label_scenarios.interpretation: Hypothetical transfer of the rounded experimental training-pool ratio to a one-tonne batch; not a demonstrated industrial requirement.
Original higher batch labelling budget; not an empirically validated domain-shift safety margin.

physical_model.soc_definition: Representative arrival SOC relative to the remaining usable capacity; not a fitted within-batch distribution.
physical_model.C_rate_reference: Nominal capacity; full discharge time therefore scales with retention.
physical_model.full_charge_time_rationale: Approximate CC shortening and CV lengthening as compensating with ageing; this is a user-specified simplification, not a universal empirical law.
physical_model.efficiency_rule: Apply charge efficiency only to charging grid energy; do not multiply charge duration by retention or divide time by efficiency.
physical_model.baseline_rule: Keep original B0/B1 snapshots; in B2 subtract the same initial-state de-energisation baseline for every method.

one_at_a_time.grid_rule: Use 21 equally spaced points plus any reference values not already present; do not round away the 6.5% marker.
one_at_a_time.fixed_input_rule: All other free inputs use registry proposal_base, otherwise fixed value. Do not randomly draw wage, tariff, charge efficiency, equipment or other inputs in deterministic sensitivity analysis; derived quantities are always recalculated.
one_at_a_time.derived_parameter_rule: Recalculate every dependency; never independently perturb equipment_rate while also varying its drivers.

two_factor_grids.purpose: Locate budget/SOC sensitivity over the revised 0.2-0.6 range, entirely below the partial-charge SOC limit of 0.75.
Joint response of battery state variables at fixed operating and economic inputs.
Joint response of labelling budget and retention at arrival SOC 0.4 and other fixed inputs.

protocol_applicability.partial_charge_rule: initial_soc + partial_charge_soc_increment <= 1, plus required feature-window availability
protocol_applicability.inapplicable_method_policy: Preserve the draw and all feasible method outputs; mark only the inapplicable method and its paired savings unavailable. Never substitute zero, clip SOC or resample away the infeasible region.
protocol_applicability.paired_summary_domain: Use draw IDs where both paired methods are feasible; report the valid count, original draw count, applicability fraction and conditional domain. Other comparators retain their own feasible domains.
protocol_applicability.all_comparator_summary_domain: Use the common feasible intersection and disclose its coverage. Do not interpret protocol inapplicability as a win, a loss or a full-domain economic result.

monte_carlo.marginal_distribution_rule: Use the 15 triangular distributions and candidate triplets in the registry, including label_fraction; the uniform repeat remains a separately labelled distribution-shape check.
monte_carlo.label_fraction_policy: Sample p from triangular (0.05,0.15,0.30) in each joint draw and share it across all learning methods; deployment fraction is derived as 1-p. The 6.5% and 15% fixed values remain deterministic sensitivity references, not separate primary Monte Carlo runs. Full-batch RPT remains independent of p.
monte_carlo.within_batch_cell_sampling: Optional separate layer; do not conflate cell heterogeneity with uncertainty in the batch mean.
monte_carlo.regional_correlation_policy: Exploratory factor envelope assumes the listed free drivers independent; publish this assumption. Prefer sourced coherent regional blocks when claiming regional applicability.
monte_carlo.invalid_draw_policy: Record reasons by method and preserve the original draw matrix. Exclude a draw only from comparisons involving an inapplicable method; truly invalid shared inputs invalidate all affected outputs. Follow protocol_applicability, report conditional coverage and never clip an impossible SOC trajectory silently.
monte_carlo.distribution_shape_check: Repeat triangular marginals as uniform over identical bounds and report material changes.
monte_carlo.interval_label: 95% simulation uncertainty interval conditional on stated assumptions

convergence_targets.if_not_converged: Increase sample size and document unresolved numerical precision; do not claim automatic sufficiency of 50000 draws.

structural_scenario_execution.reason: Retain the following extensions as future candidates; current deterministic sensitivity has three drivers and Monte Carlo has 15 triangular inputs under fixed workflow structure. Protocol applicability is still checked in the core analysis.

structural_scenarios.additional_cell_formats: Only add when mass, capacity, voltage and compatible protocol are all available; do not vary mass alone to represent an IFR32135.

structural_scenarios.rule: Do not combine both charges for the same maintenance item.
Moving rest off a tester requires rack and handling accounting or an explicit omission; do not equate off-tester with free.
Apply gross and baseline energy consistently; zero is an exclusion scenario, not measured zero.

These optional stress values lie outside the current core SOC range 0.2-0.6 and are not executed in the main analysis. Check protocol applicability at every value and mark the fixed 0.25 partial-charge increment inapplicable above 0.75. Do not silently cap SOC.
Require explicit fixed initial labels, validation labels and relabelling policy; no automatic claim that 142 labels generalise across all batches.

reporting_rules.budget_interpretation: Primary Monte Carlo intervals include uncertainty in the sampled labelling budget and must not be labelled as conditional results at fixed p=0.065 or p=0.15. Those values are reference points in deterministic sensitivity analysis.
reporting_rules.pairing: Calculate savings and ratios within each draw before taking quantiles; use the feasible domains and coverage reporting defined in protocol_applicability.
reporting_rules.zero_denominator: For comparator <= 0, mark relative reduction unavailable and retain the absolute difference.
reporting_rules.negative_saving: Preserve negative values and the fraction of such draws.
reporting_rules.joint_claim: For an across-all-comparators lower-bound claim, use the per-draw minimum or the explicit joint event; marginal intervals do not establish a simultaneous guarantee.
reporting_rules.degenerate_relative_interval: Report analytic constancy when common factors cancel; do not add artificial independent method noise.
reporting_rules.structural_envelope: Label as scenario range, not a 95% probability interval unless scenario probabilities are justified.
reporting_rules.rounding: Retain full precision in machine-readable outputs; display approximately whole USD and one decimal for kWh, kg CO2 and percent when convergence and input evidence support it.
reporting_rules.no_premature_claim: Do not replace the abstract with fabricated intervals or state that sensitivity analysis has been completed before execution.

quality_checks: Five B0 totals match the original workbook snapshot within 1e-8 USD.
Same cells, initial state and terminal state in diagnostic and common-baseline ledgers.
In the simplified common-RPT model, proposed cost equals p times RPT cost.
At p=0 proposed incremental testing is zero; at p=1 simplified proposed and RPT match.
Doubling the functional mass doubles additive burdens without changing percentage reductions in the linear model.
Shared grid intensity makes relative CO2 reduction equal relative grid-energy reduction when it is the sole emission source.
Equipment rate is derived from its drivers and is not an additional independent random input.
Deterministic sensitivity varies only retention, initial_soc and label_fraction; Monte Carlo samples exactly the 15 registry triangular inputs, including label_fraction.
Charge efficiency uses triangular (0.85,0.90,0.95), equivalent cell mass uses (45,47.5,50) g and labelling fraction uses (0.05,0.15,0.30); p=0.065 and p=0.15 remain explicit sensitivity markers.
Full charge from empty is fixed at 1.5 h, RPT rest at 10 min and multi-SOC relaxation at 1 h in both analyses; arrival charge time depends on SOC but not retention.
Capacity and energy retention are the same variable; deployment_fraction is exactly 1-label_fraction, not an independent draw.
Same seed and frozen configuration reproduce the draw matrix and summaries.
Reported percentiles are computed from paired differences or ratios, not differences of marginal percentiles.
Parameter ranges, distribution shapes and structural exclusions retain their evidence labels.
Initial SOC uses triangular (0.2, 0.4, 0.6) with B2 reference 0.4; retention uses triangular (0.6, 0.8, 0.9), and the SOC grid spans 0.2-0.6. B0/B1 reference inputs remain frozen at original SOC 0.6.
Annual utilisation uses triangular (0.85, 0.90, 0.95); the upper-bound extension is labelled exploratory, and the uniform shape check uses the same 0.85-0.95 bounds.
For the fixed 0.25 partial-charge increment, SOC 0.75 satisfies the upper-SOC constraint and SOC 0.80 does not; failure does not discard other feasible methods or count as zero cost.
Training-pool, additional-pool-use and TEA-batch denominators are never conflated.
